briefing: This is {PATRON}, running things at {HERE}. A canister broke free from the station a single jump out, and it is still drifting.
Scoop it up and bring it back to {HERE}. Do that, and there is good pay waiting for the commander.

find.arrive: Scoop the canister adrift near {TARGET} for {PAY}.
find.success: The canister is secured, ready for the run home for {PAY}.
find.fail: The canister is gone, and the job ends without {PAY}.

home.arrive: Carry the canister back to {TARGET} to collect {PAY}.
home.success: The canister is delivered, and {PAY} is paid in full.
home.fail: The canister never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays unpaid.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} has left word at {WORLD}, asking for the commander directly.

rumour.far: Word on the board says {PATRON} at {WORLD} lost a canister and wants it found.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the canister is still out there, and the offer stands.

dossier.news: {PATRON} confirms a canister is loose off {WORLD}, and salvage work waits for a taker.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took on a canister recovery job at {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the canister was back at {WORLD}, and the job was done.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the canister was lost for good, and the job failed.

find.success: On day {DAY}, the commander scooped the canister adrift near {WORLD}.
find.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the canister was destroyed near {WORLD} before it could be scooped.
find.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander lost the trail of the canister near {WORLD}.

home.success: On day {DAY}, the commander delivered the canister to {WORLD}.
home.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander failed to bring the canister back to {WORLD}.

dossier.title: Canister Adrift
